column4: CONFIRMED lineage biology, not a bin defect: the 45-51 aa class is the wobbly possum disease virus E protein (NC_026811.2, 45 aa), the shortest E in the family; the 67-84 aa class is every other lineage (EAV 67, PRRSV-2 73, SHFV 81). Both are the ORF2 small hydrophobic protein and one orthogroup. Family range 45-94 aa, lit/structural.md table 2.3; E measured as an essential virion protein in EAV (PMID 10400725) and PRRSV (PMID 11504553).

CONFIRMED lineage biology: wobbly possum disease virus GP4 is 83 aa against 148-185 aa elsewhere (PRRSV-1 183, EAV 152). It is genuinely short, not a fragment -- the 83 aa form is what NC_026811.2 annotates and it is the only GP4 that genome has. GP4 forms the minor-glycoprotein heterotrimer with GP2 and GP3 (PMID 12743278).
Same finding as the GP4 SPLIT above, reported per member: this IS the 83 aa wobbly possum disease virus GP4, measured against a module median of 178 that is set by PRRSV. Not a fragment.

CONFIRMED lineage biology and the reason this module keeps one nsp2 feature: the 571-576 aa class is Alphaarterivirus (EAV nsp2 = pp1ab 261-831 = 571 aa, PMID 7622476 for the PLP2 protease and UniProt P19811 for the Gly831 bond) and the 830-1196 aa class is Betaarterivirus (PRRSV-1 1078, PRRSV-2 1196, Fang & Snijder Table 1, PMID 20696193). One orthogroup, two lineage length classes. Every member of both classes begins at the measured nsp1beta/nsp2 cleavage residue; the 279 internal typing amplicons that do not were removed by the junction filter.
